Use case: compositing.
Asset type: Chinese release cover for the World of Warcraft addon 荔枝组队 (Lychee LFG), version 1.0.0.
Create a polished landscape 16:9 marketing cover, preferably 1920x1080, using the three provided inputs.
Input image 1 is the exact anonymized FIND GROUP interface screenshot to feature. It is the primary product content; preserve its visual layout, all UI text, proportions, icons and anonymous player names. Place it as a straight, flat, undistorted screenshot on the right, large and clear, with all outer edges visible. No perspective, no browser frame, no invented UI or extra panels.
Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the neighboring Lychee Talent release cover. Match its near-black textured background, strong red brushed abstract accents framing the outer edges, bold red/white Chinese typography and focused hierarchy. Do not copy any Lychee Talent words or talent UI.
Input image 3 is the current Lychee Group logo: red lychee with a small white group-of-people badge. Use this logo next to the product name at the upper left, retaining its silhouette, original colors and group badge.
Composition: left approximately 39% contains brand lockup, large slogan and a compact feature line; right approximately 58% contains the full anonymized find-group screenshot, with quiet black margins so the UI is readable. The screenshot may be uniformly scaled to fit, but do not crop it, re-layout it or change its content. Leave clear separation between copy and screenshot. Background should remain restrained behind the screenshot.
Text outside the screenshot, exactly:
"荔枝组队" (upper-left main brand, 荔枝 in red and 组队 in white)
"Lychee LFG" (smaller English subtitle)
"组队"
"更省心" (these two lines form the large white slogan)
"寻求组队 · 创建组队 · 荔枝笔记" (small secondary copy, wrap to two lines only if needed)
Use only these words. No additional badges, fake stats, version labels, watermark, game scenery or player identities. No original real player names. Keep the real screenshot as the main visual and make the cover clearly part of the same black-and-red brand family as reference image 2.

Use case: text-localization
Asset type: anonymized in-game screenshot for the LycheeGroup addon release gallery and inline product description.

Primary request: make a minimal privacy edit. Replace the five player identity text lines, in top-to-bottom order, with exactly “申请者 01”, “申请者 02”, “申请者 03”, “申请者 04”, “申请者 05”. Remove ALL original character names and ALL realm/server names, including the names after hyphens. Keep the class color of each replaced name. These are the only five player identities.
Also remove the unrelated other-addon toolbar text/icons along the top-right edge (the row beginning 自定义 and 集合石 plus 倒数/重置) by cleanly restoring the existing purple game scenery beneath. Keep the Lychee red fruit floating button and its white count 9 at the top, and keep 取消招募.
Composition/framing: preserve the source screenshot's landscape proportions, the entire applicant panel, and enough of the original purple in-game environment to clearly show this is a floating overlay. Do not add a frame, caption, headline, watermark, or additional UI.
Invariants: preserve the existing dark translucent rounded card shapes, card grouping, spacing, positions, role/spec icons, class/spec Chinese labels, 暂无分数, item levels 315 / 323 / 320 / 325 / 313, the two existing applicant notes, green invite ticks and pink decline crosses. Keep the first two applicants grouped in ONE card and the remaining three applicants in three individual cards. Preserve the original game scene and UI appearance as faithfully as possible. No redesign or invented controls.
Privacy constraints: no original player name or realm may remain legible anywhere. Do not replace identity text with blur. Use the five exact generic applicant labels above.
